title: Every tensor on the device
description: The plain placement: weights, caches and state all live on the device, and a model whose tensors do not fit the device's free memory at the served context is refused before anything loads. A placement that keeps some tensors in host memory or files is compared with it where everything fits. With off_device it also places a model larger than the device whose routed experts and lookup tables reach it through a device expert cache and a host table: groups named by those prefixes go to host memory in the prefixes' order while they fit, then to files, the rest stays on the device; slots(tensors, budget, bundle_bytes) sizes the cache's own slots from what the device groups leave (the KV pool's unused pages lend it more at run time).

reserve_mib.description: MiB of the device free memory kept out of the plan (CUDA context, workspaces, graph pools, a desktop on the same GPU)

off_device.description: comma-separated name prefixes of groups that live off the device, in order of preference for host memory ("experts.,tables.": routed experts' bundles, then lookup tables); empty: every group on the device

files.description: off-device groups that host memory cannot hold go to files (false: refused)
